records.title: Daily Smoking Prevalence Among Residents Aged 18 - 74 Years, Annual
records.footnote: Data pertain to Singapore residents (i.e. Singapore citizens and permanent residents) aged 18 - 74 years and are age-standardised to the World Health Organisation (WHO) World Standard Population. Data are used for SDG 3.a.1 'Age-standardized prevalence of current tobacco use among persons aged 15 years and older'. Please refer to the Sustainable Development Goals (SDG) Global Metadata (https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/metadata) for more information on SDG 3.a.1.
